title: "Sun-Kissed Shores" in Seagrove Beach | 30A | Coast Property Management – Coast Properties
meta_description: "Sun-Kissed Shores" in Seagrove Beach | 30A | Coast Property Management
description_expanded: Welcome to “Sun-Kissed Shores” - our luxury 6 Bedroom, 5.5 Bathroom beach home in Seagrove Beach. LOCATION: “Sun-kissed Shores” is located in the heart of Scenic Highway 30A in Seagrove Beach. It is only 0.3 miles from the home to the One Seagrove beach access point - a short walk or even shorter bike ride. Although well hidden on a quiet street with no through traffic, this home is steps away from some excellent local restaurants. Just around the corner is the newly-opened Greenway Station which also offers exceptional dining locations and retail stores. PROPERTY OVERVIEW: First Floor Features: Owner Suite 1: King bed, en-suite bathroom with double vanities and a walk-in shower Fully stocked kitchen Dining area Two living rooms, both with large smart TVs Dry bar area with wine cooler Laundry Room Half Bathroom Large optionally-heated* outdoor pool Al fresco dining and seating area Poolside sun loungers Full cabana bathroom with walk-in shower so swimmers can shower, change, or use the restroom without having to come through the main house. Second Floor Features: Owner Suite 2: King bed, en-suite bathroom with double vanities, walk-in shower, and a separate soaking tub Bedroom 3: King bed, en-suite bathroom with double vanities and a walk-in shower (accessible from hallway) Bedroom 4: King bed, shared Jack-and-Jill bathroom with double vanities, and a walk-in shower Bedroom 5: Four queen beds in a custom bunk room, shared Jack-and-Jill bathroom with double vanities, and a walk-in shower Bedroom 6: Four twin beds in a custom bunk room, shared hallway bathroom with double vanities, and a walk-in shower Laundry room AMENITIES: ✔ A six-seater electric golf cart ✔ Six brand-new beach cruisers ✔ Private, optionally heated pool* ✔ Fully fenced-in yard ✔ Beach gear (umbrellas, chairs, boogie boards, etc.) ✔ Gas grill ✔ Two travel cribs ✔ TVs in each bedroom ✔ Fresh linens & towels (including beach towels) ✔ Fully equipped kitchen with all essential cutlery and cookware ✔ Private driveway accommodating up to six vehicles To enhance your stay, we also provide a starter supply of premium, eco-friendly guest essentials, including: Body Wash, Shampoo & Conditioner Hand Soap, Dish Soap & Dishwasher Pods Toilet Paper, Paper Towels & Facial Tissues ️ Trash Bags & Dish Sponge Laundry Detergent GUEST SUPPORT: Need assistance? Coast’s dedicated management team is available to help with anything you need—just give us a call! IMPORTANT NOTES: Age Requirement: The primary guest must be 25 or older to book. Parking: The home comes with a two-car garage as well as ample driveway parking for six cars. Check-In Policy: Please do not arrive before your scheduled check-in time. No Pets & No Smoking: This home has a strict no-pet policy. Unauthorized pets will result in immediate eviction and loss of rental fees, with the guest responsible for any damages. The home is also strictly non-smoking. *Pool heating can be added to your booking for an additional fee of $50/night. Please contact our team prior to your stay to have this arranged.

Cleanliness: All towels and bedding washed in hot water that's at least 60ºC
